correctness.rationale: The affine group F5 ⋊ F5^× has fourteen subgroups in six conjugacy classes: 1,C2,C4,C5,D5,F. The compact unordered Abrams D2(K5) has cubical cells (10,30,15), whose barycentric flag complex has (55,180,120). Orbit enumeration and independent Burnside fixed-flag averages give flag vectors (55,180,120),(31,92,60),(16,46,30),(11,36,24),(9,20,12),(5,10,6). I independently reconstructed those exact integer flag vectors and Euler characteristics -5,-1,0,-1,1,1. Examined complete verifier source implementing local circle/interval vertex-link tests, boundary counts 0,1,1,0,1,1 and orientation-sign consistency (nonorientable for first four, orientable for last two). Compact surface classification yields nonorientable genera 7 and 3, punctured Klein, Möbius, and disks. The explicit same-edge/incident-edge coordinate deformation on continuous collision-free pairs is equivariant and strongly retracts to D; consequently X/H has same HOMOTOPY type, not a homeomorphism to compact quotient. The independent f-vector checks do not alone prove local orientability; that is established by the exhaustive source-code incidence proof.
residual_risks: Compact quotient and noncompact continuous orbit space are only homotopy equivalent.
Independent program replicated f-vectors/Euler; full link and orientability verification was examined from deterministic source code rather than independently recomputed from scratch.
